Container.Name: sabthrottle
Container.Overview: Throttles SABnzbd automatically while Jellyfin is actively streaming (e.g. via NZBDav), so streams always have enough bandwidth.
Container.Description: Receives Jellyfin webhook events (PlaybackStart/Stop/Progress) and adjusts the SABnzbd speed limit dynamically. While at least one stream is active, SABnzbd is throttled to a configurable percentage of full speed. When all streams end, full speed is restored.

Config.Name: Webhook Port
Config.Description: HTTP port the webhook receiver listens on

Config.Name: SAB_URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your SABnzbd instance

Config.Name: SAB_API_KEY
Config.Description: SABnzbd API key (Config -> General -> API Key)

Config.Name: THROTTLE_PERCENT
Config.Description: SAB speed limit (in percent) while a stream is active

Config.Name: FULL_PERCENT
Config.Description: SAB speed limit (in percent) when no stream is active

Config.Name: WEBHOOK_TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional shared secret to authenticate the Jellyfin webhook

Config.Name: NZBDAV_PATH_PREFIX
Config.Description: If set, only throttle when the playing item path contains this string (e.g. /mnt/user/nzbdav)

Config.Name: SESSION_TIMEOUT_SEC
Config.Description: Drop sessions that have not sent a heartbeat for this many seconds
